purpose: Test an explicit nonzero local Landau-frame vorticity solution in a two-scalar, fixed-background specialization of C1. Not the C1Q cosmology, global rotation, a CMB prediction, or a historical simulation recreation.
action: -1/2 ((partial phi)^2+(partial chi)^2) on prescribed Minkowski spacetime; C1 fields F,W active; E inactive; all masses, xi, g, h zero; no gauge or other fields

units.scalar_amplitude: Phi_star has mass dimension one; normalized stress = T L^2/Phi_star^2
units.physical_vorticity: omega_hat/L in natural units; angular rate c omega_hat/L in s^-1 for L in metres

orientation: right-handed x,y,z; epsilon^{0123}=+1; no Galactic axis identification
initial_data: At tau=0 fields and spatial gradients vanish; field time derivatives have prescribed inhomogeneous orthogonal spatial gradients. Total energy-frame velocity and vorticity vanish. Initial data are not homogeneous/isotropic.
congruence: unique future-directed unit timelike eigenvector T^{mu nu}u_nu=-rho_L u^mu
vorticity: omega_hat^mu=(1/2) epsilon^{mu nu rho sigma} u_nu partial_{y^rho} u_sigma

prediction.definitions: f=p+alpha*xi; g=q+beta*eta; A=f^2+g^2; d1=r+alpha^2*tau^2; d2=r+beta^2*tau^2; vx=-tau*alpha*f/d1; vy=-tau*beta*g/d2; s=1-vx^2-vy^2
prediction.root: r-A+tau^2*(alpha^2*f^2/d1+beta^2*g^2/d2)=0; physical branch r -> A as tau -> 0, s>0
prediction.individual_fields: each normalized timelike scalar-gradient congruence has identically zero projected vorticity
prediction.isotropic_orientations: Haar rotation of the entire initial configuration: E[omega_vector]=0, E[omega_i omega_j]=|omega|^2 delta_ij/3; nonzero realization RMS does not select a universal axis

symbolic: spatial curl and velocity-time cross product equal the proposed expression
verification.independent_numerics: 4x4 mixed stress eigenvector, followed by fourth-order centered finite differences and full Levi-Civita contraction; compare to scalar-root analytical expression
controls: time reversal: omega_hat_z odd in tau
verification.convergence: Report every step and every error. Finest-step absolute gate is primary numerical criterion; no mandatory ratio near roundoff or a zero signal.

orientation_null.draw_order: array shape (10000,4), C order, independent standard_normal; normalize each quaternion; components (w,x,y,z); standard active proper rotation matrix
orientation_null.distribution: Haar SO(3), obtained from uniform S^3 unit quaternions; rotates full configuration, not only output vector
orientation_null.expectations: mean rotated vorticity zero, normalized second moment identity/3
orientation_null.diagnostic_gate: report component means and second moments; each mean absolute < 6/sqrt(3N), each second-moment deviation absolute < 6/sqrt(N). Broad fixed engineering controls, not discovery significance.

no_data_used: No CMB maps, historical PBH outputs, or prediction-lock v1 seed are consumed. This is a conditional mathematical construction.
exclusions: No scale L or field amplitude selected by C1
No EFMW-specific coupling responsible: all such couplings are zero
No coherent cosmological axis, rotation rate, CMB transfer or likelihood
No contradiction of C1Q v1 single-field/linear scope
change_rule: Keep this file and source snapshots immutable. Corrections require an explicit new protocol version or a documented implementation-only correction that does not alter predictions, parameters, tolerances, seed, or scientific scope.
